question_text:
The unit cell for $\mathrm{Fe}{3} \mathrm{O}{4}\left(\mathrm{FeO}-\mathrm{Fe}{2} \mathrm{O}{3}\right)$ has cubic symmetry with a unit cell edge length of 0.839 nm . If the density of this material is $5.24 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, compute its atomic packing factor. For this computation, you will need to use the ionic radii listed in  table 3.4 . The atomic weights of iron and oxygen $\left(A{\mathrm{Fe}}\right.$ and $\left.A{\mathrm{O}}\right)$ are $55.85 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mol}$ and $16.00 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mol}$.

"Table 3.4
Ionic Radii for Several Cations and Anions for a Coordination Number of 6
\begin{tabular}{|l|l|l|l|}
\hline Cation & Ionic Radius (nm) & Anion & Ionic Radius (nm) \\
\hline $\mathrm{Al}^{3+}$ & 0.053 & $\mathrm{Br}^{-}$ & 0.196 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ba}^{2+}$ & 0.136 & $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ & 0.181 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ca}^{2+}$ & 0.100 & $\mathrm{F}^{-}$ & 0.133 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Cs}^{+}$ & 0.170 & $\mathrm{I}^{-}$ & 0.220 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ & 0.077 & $\mathrm{O}^{2-}$ & 0.140 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ & 0.069 & $\mathrm{S}^{2-}$ & 0.184 \\
\hline $\mathrm{K}^{+}$ & 0.138 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Mg}^{2+}$ & 0.072 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}$ & 0.067 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ & 0.102 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}$ & 0.069 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Si}^{4+}$ & 0.040 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ti}^{4+}$ & 0.061 & & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}"
response:
## Reasoning

**Step 1: Determine formula units per unit cell.**

Fe₃O₄ has the inverse spinel structure. Using the density to verify:

$$n = \frac{\rho \, V_c \, N_A}{M_{\text{Fe}_3\text{O}_4}}$$

With $M = 3(55.85)+4(16.00)=231.55$ g/mol and $V_c = (0.839\times10^{-7}\text{ cm})^3$, this gives $n \approx 8.05 \approx 8$ formula units per unit cell — consistent with the spinel structure.

**Step 2: Count ions in the unit cell.**

Each formula unit Fe₃O₄ = FeO·Fe₂O₃ contains 1 Fe²⁺, 2 Fe³⁺, and 4 O²⁻. With 8 formula units:
- 8 Fe²⁺ ions, 16 Fe³⁺ ions, 32 O²⁻ ions

**Step 3: Compute ionic volumes** using Table 3.4 radii (r_Fe²⁺ = 0.077 nm, r_Fe³⁺ = 0.069 nm, r_O²⁻ = 0.140 nm):

$$V_{\text{ions}} = 8\cdot\tfrac{4}{3}\pi(0.077)^3 + 16\cdot\tfrac{4}{3}\pi(0.069)^3 + 32\cdot\tfrac{4}{3}\pi(0.140)^3 = 0.4051\text{ nm}^3$$

**Step 4: Atomic packing factor.**

$$\text{APF} = \frac{V_{\text{ions}}}{V_c} = \frac{0.4051}{(0.839)^3} = \frac{0.4051}{0.5906} \approx 0.686$$

$$\boxed{0.686}$$
